Maintain technical standards, procedures, runbooks, architecture diagrams, control evidence, and operational documentation. Contribute to security roadmaps, platform modernization, technical proposals, design reviews, audit responses, risk assessments, and policy or standard development. Communicate technical risks and recommended actions clearly to both technical teams and leadership; escalate material risks, control failures, and unresolved remediation issues through established governance channels. Participate in an on-call or incident-response rotation as required by the operating model. Strong knowledge of infrastructure security principles, including system hardening, vulnerability management, privileged access, network segmentation, encryption, logging, monitoring, incident response, backup security, and disaster recovery. Experience with SIEM, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, configuration compliance, and security incident-management tools. Ability to interpret technical logs and security alerts, perform structured troubleshooting, collect defensible evidence, assess risk, and coordinate remediation across multiple teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills, disciplined documentation practices, and the ability to explain technical risk to non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike, or a comparable SIEM, including log onboarding, use-case development, detection tuning, dashboards, and incident investigation. Experience with PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar scripting and automation technologies. Knowledge of CIS Benchmarks, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, MITRE ATT&CK, CVSS, and risk-based control assessment. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, Security+, VMware VCP or VCAP, or comparable infrastructure and security credentials. Experience supporting regulated, validated, or audit-sensitive environments. Technical Knowledge Areas VMware Security vSphere, vCenter Server, ESXi, HA/DRS concepts, permissions, SSO, certificates, Secure Boot, TPM, lockdown mode, host firewall, logging, patching, hardening, and lifecycle security. Identity & Access Active Directory, federation concepts, RBAC, least privilege, privileged access, service accounts, access reviews, authentication, and authorization monitoring. Infrastructure Windows Server, Linux, server hardware, shared storage, backup and recovery, PKI, DNS/DHCP, VLANs, routing, load balancers, firewalls, and management networks. Security Operations SIEM, event correlation, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, threat detection, incident response, evidence preservation, root-cause analysis, and remediation tracking. Governance & Compliance Security standards, risk assessments, control testing, exceptions, audit evidence, metrics, policy implementation, and technical documentation. Automation PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, Bash, APIs, configuration validation, reporting automation, and repeatable security control checks. Behavioral Competencies Security ownership and sound judgment, with the ability to balance risk reduction, service availability, and operational practicality. Analytical troubleshooting and disciplined decision-making during high-impact security or infrastructure incidents. Attention to detail in production changes, access control, evidence collection, remediation validation, and technical documentation. Clear, respectful communication and effective collaboration across security, infrastructure, engineering, compliance, and vendor teams. Continuous-improvement mindset with a focus on automation, measurable controls, resilience, and reduction of recurring risk. Ability to work independently, manage concurrent priorities, and operate effectively across regions and time zones Key Accountabilities Strategic Advance the VMware and on-premises security roadmap, architecture, lifecycle, and modernization priorities.
